status: Final window row collection and projected checkpoint-output ownership integrated; full acceptance remains open
implementation: Window projection supports a synchronous owned-batch receiver. It detaches owned output through the existing row projection handoff before the producer releases its batch.
Window QueryResult.toOwnedArray uses the shared owned-row collector. Plain toArray transfers the collected result to caller management at return; owned results stay charged until release.
Resumable window execution uses the same collector instead of spreading plain batches into an untracked array. Collected projected output stays owned through all awaited checkpoint writes.

Admission failure releases collected output; successful plain/checkpoint return transfers rows to caller management. Collector metadata and final reference-array allocation follow the existing generic collector contract.

scope: Owned window result remains charged across a sibling allocation until release
Cumulative projection growth rejects at a 64 KiB cap for plain, owned and checkpoint collection
Projected output stays charged during a delayed checkpoint write and releases after success or write failure
